data.narrative:
Aon3D is a Series C-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $14.4M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of nine comparable companies—one public (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private firms in robotics and manufacturing at same or adjacent stages, including Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base of $14M and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yields $24M. Peer-median analysis across seven same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer sample includes Series B and Series D companies, reflecting the sparse density of exact-stage matches in frontier robotics.

The triangulated range is $21M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $837M. The wide spread reflects material methodological divergence: stage-progression anchors to observed capital deployed, while peer-median reflects market valuations assigned to later-stage robotics companies. Resolution of this range depends critically on Aon3D's revenue trajectory, go-to-market traction relative to peers, and whether the peer set (skewed toward Series B/D) appropriately reflects Series C positioning. Additional data on revenue, customer concentration, and capital efficiency would narrow this band.
